description: Owner-authorized single-account trust policy for the project's security review and REM-P0-006 evidence-approval path

authorized_security_reviewer.scope: SNAD project security review and the external reviewer approval step for REM-P0-006
authorized_security_reviewer.identity_evidence: A GitHub pull-request review submitted by this exact account

controls.description: Workflow must authenticate via GitHub Actions OIDC token from the expected repository.
All commits in the assessed release range must be signed (GPG, SSH, or S/MIME).
Closure workflow must execute in a GitHub Environment with required protection rules; the sole trusted reviewer identity must be configured where GitHub environment review rules support it.
The assessed release SHA must be a direct ancestor of the workflow HEAD and match the explicitly authorized release SHA.

The only accepted external GitHub reviewer identity for this project security-review path is abdulrhmansenan1985-creator. The workflow must verify the reviewer's GitHub identity and record the review against the exact assessed release SHA. This account designation is the project's governance trust decision; it does not by itself prove organizational independence or replace required technical evidence, retesting, Security Governance review, or Project Owner approval.

rules.description: All critical controls must pass for REM-P0-006 closure. The sole trusted reviewer identity is fixed to the account allowlist above; required evidence, retesting, Security Governance approval, Project Owner approval, and exact-release-SHA binding remain mandatory.
Readiness mode requires OIDC identity verification only.
